title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Documented University of Portland rituals, recurring campus celebrations, and Pilot-specific practices.

cards.title: Light a candle at the Bell Tower Ceremony
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation • Academic Quad
cards.notes: During orientation, join the candlelit gathering in the Academic Quad and listen to the Bell Tower music marking the start of the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A candlelit orientation ritual beneath UP’s Bell Tower.
cards.evidence_claim: UP describes the Bell Tower Ceremony as a beloved tradition in which new students fill the Academic Quad, light candles, and hear traditional Bell Tower music.
cards.source_title: Live Music, Food Trucks, Seminars and Soccer: In-person Orientation is back!
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of new-student orientation; check the current orientation schedule for participation details.

cards.entity_name: Founders’ Day: A Celebration of Student Scholarship
cards.title: Spend Founders’ Day with student scholarship
cards.subtitle: Annual campus celebration
cards.notes: Look for the annual program of presentations, panels, recitals, and senior recognition that connects UP’s founding story with current student work.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide pause for UP history and undergraduate scholarship.
cards.evidence_claim: UP says Founders’ Day dates to the University’s origins, was revitalized in 2001, and includes student presentations, panels, recitals, and senior recognition.
cards.source_title: Founders’ Day: A Celebration of Student Scholarship (Apr. 4)
cards.access_notes: The date and program vary by academic year; consult UP’s current events calendar.

cards.title: Mark Wally Pilot’s February birthday
cards.subtitle: Pilot mascot tradition
cards.notes: Watch for birthday-season Wally appearances and museum displays; the University Museum traces the celebration to Wally Pilot Week in February 1978.
cards.short_summary: UP’s river-pilot mascot has a documented February birthday tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Museum reports that Wally Pilot Week ran February 13–17, 1978, and that Wally’s birthday has been celebrated around those dates in later years.
cards.access_notes: Celebration details are event-dependent; historical Wally artifacts are displayed in the Museum Heritage Room.

cards.title: Join Pilots After Dark at the Pilot House
cards.subtitle: Weekend campus programming
cards.notes: Check the weekend listing for an all-ages concert, comedy show, trivia night, or game show held through UP’s recurring late-night series.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, all-ages weekend program at the Pilot House.
cards.evidence_claim: UP describes Pilots After Dark as a late-night series held nearly every Friday and Saturday for students of all ages, with concerts, comedy, trivia, and more.
cards.access_notes: UP describes the series as nearly every Friday and Saturday night; individual events and locations vary.

cards.title: Gather for the President’s Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: Annual event • Academic Quad
cards.notes: Watch UP’s December events listings for the annual Academic Quad gathering and use the posted schedule for the current year’s details.
cards.short_summary: An annually listed early-December tree-lighting on the Academic Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: UP’s School of Business events page lists the University of Portland’s annual President’s Christmas Tree Lighting on the Academic Quad.
cards.source_title: Events – University of Portland School of Business Blog
cards.access_notes: The cited listing gives a prior-year date; confirm the current December event announcement before attending.

cards.title: Hear Villa Hall’s drum squad at soccer
cards.subtitle: Villa Maria Hall • UP soccer student section
cards.notes: At a UP soccer match, listen for the Villa Hall drum squad leading cheers from the student section in kilts.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall drum squad that leads soccer cheers.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Museum states that Villa Hall’s drum squad leads the student section for UP soccer games, playing drums and leading cheers in kilts.
cards.source_title: Campus Buildings, History and Fun Facts
cards.access_notes: Occurs in connection with UP soccer events; ticketing and access depend on the individual match.

cards.title: Spot Villa’s rooftop gorilla at move-in
cards.subtitle: Villa Maria Hall • Orientation
cards.notes: During new-student move-in and orientation, look up at Villa Hall for the large inflatable gorilla used to welcome incoming residents.
cards.short_summary: Villa Hall’s orientation welcome includes a rooftop inflatable gorilla.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Museum says Villa Hall welcomes new residents during move-in and orientation with a larger-than-life inflatable gorilla on its rooftop.
cards.source_title: Campus Buildings, History and Fun Facts
cards.access_notes: Visible during the residence-hall move-in and orientation period; do not enter restricted roof areas.

cards.title: Celebrate the Pilot family at Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Annual fall campus weekend
cards.notes: Use the published weekend schedule to pair a campus activity with Homecoming Mass or a Pilots After Dark program.
cards.short_summary: A fall weekend that brings families, alumni, and current Pilots together.
cards.evidence_claim: UP’s 2025 Family Weekend & Homecoming schedule included a President’s Welcome, service project, Homecoming Mass, soccer, and Pilots After Dark.
cards.access_notes: This is an annual event; dates, registration, and individual activity access change each year.

cards.entity_name: Wally Pilot at Athletic and Campus Events
cards.title: Find Wally at a Pilots event
cards.subtitle: UP mascot appearances
cards.notes: Bring your camera to a University or athletic event where Wally Pilot may appear as the campus’s long-running river-pilot mascot.
cards.short_summary: Wally Pilot has represented UP spirit at events for decades.
cards.evidence_claim: UP reports that Wally Pilot has exemplified University of Portland spirit at athletic and campus events for 75 years.
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances depend on the event; consult the specific UP athletics or campus event listing.

cards.title: Begin the year with Orientation Mass
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation • Chiles Center
cards.notes: If it is included in the current orientation schedule, attend the all-faiths-welcome Mass as one of the opening weekend’s community gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A faith-and-community gathering included in UP orientation programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UP’s orientation announcement described Orientation Mass as open to all faiths and part of the start-of-year orientation program.
cards.source_title: Live Music, Food Trucks, Seminars and Soccer: In-person Orientation is back!
cards.access_notes: Participation is optional and scheduling varies; review the current orientation itinerary.
